name: SF-ONE
description: "A floor-type speaker system with a sound field control function.The SF-ONE consists of a speaker system SF-X 1 and a sound field controller SFC-1.When listening to the sound of a stereo system, the listener hears not only the direct sound coming from the speakers but also the reflected sound coming from all directions at the same time. The sound field for stereo reproduction is composed of components such as direction, volume, phase, and delay of the reflected sound.SF-ONE pursues a rich musical sense of reality through sound field control that combines the direction, quantity, and delay degree of direct and indirect waves to optimize them. Under the guidance of Dr. Mark F. Davis, an American acoustic psychologist, it was developed by pursuing the ideal radiation pattern of speakers that determine sound field control.In order to realize a speaker with an ideal radiation pattern, we have adopted the time versus intensity exchange effect, which is an acoustopsychological phenomenon. This effect compensates for the left-to-right bias on arrival by adding a reverse bias to the amplitude. We conclude that the speaker has directivity and must emit sound more strongly in one direction than in the other. To determine the radiation pattern with the appropriate time versus intensity exchange, we repeat the hearing test to obtain a correlation diagram of amplitude versus angle that gives the optimum sound localization. This enables us to analyze the radiation pattern of sound pressure contours using computer graphics.In addition, sound reflected by walls etc. is used as an acoustic delay to maintain ideal sound image fusion, and a fully horizontal radiation pattern is established by setting a backward radiation pattern with a forward horizontal radiation pattern as a mirror object.The vertical radiation pattern is set so that the sound quality does not change significantly regardless of the position of the listener, and the sound emitted above the speaker is sufficiently limited.Fourteen speaker units are used to achieve an ideal radiation pattern.Four 10-inch cone woofers for the low range and four 4 1 / 2-inch cone midrange woofers for the middle range, mounted on each of the four sides of the floor cabinet.In addition, 6 1/2inch domed tweeters are mounted on the upper hexagonal surface for high frequency.The four sided woofer and mid-range speakers have the same characteristics on the front and rear sides and different characteristics on the inside and outside sides. These units have three characteristics in total. The six tweeters combine four types of speakers : the inside and outside sides, two inside oblique sides, and two outside oblique sides. Each speaker has a different crossover frequency, frequency characteristics, and volume.The volume is set to the maximum on the inner side (facing side) for all bands, and then the strength is adjusted on both front and rear sides, and then on the outer side.The LF/MF crossover frequency is 450 Hz and the MF/HF crossover frequency is 3.15 kHz.The crossover design is a computer-driven design that not only matches the characteristics of each driver individually to provide the optimum sound field radiation pattern, but also maintains a constant input impedance throughout the entire drive, enabling the handling of power amplifiers with excellent power response.Dedicated controller SFC-1 is attached.In addition to the equalization function that ensures the overall characteristics of the SF-ONE, the SFC-1 is equipped with an ambience adjustment that controls the subtle nuances of the sound field, a unique Low/High compensation function, a power monitor circuit for speaker protection, and an auto-balance function."

This allows the amplifier to be driven without stress even when the combined impedance is low due to the parallel connection of speakers.The input circuit is designed to withstand a maximum of + 24 dBv.It also supports two way inputs through the balanced cannon connector and 3p phone jack. When you plug in the 2p phone plug, it automatically switches to an unbalanced input.Equipped with a short-circuit detection and overcurrent detection type protector as a protection circuit.The heat generated inside the amplifier is effectively dissipated by a forced cooling system in which air taken in from the air intake section of the front panel is released to the rear panel section by a cooling fan.The fan speed can be switched between high and low levels.The front panel is made of 6 mm thick aluminum and processed to increase strength and withstand rough handling. name: BX-3

name: DX3
description: "Dbx's first CD player.DX3 is equipped with dbx's own DAIR, which enables Compression and Ambience control.Dbx's unique Digital Audio Impact Recovery (DAIR) function splits the audio band into two bands, low and high. Each band operates individually in response to musical transients, adding a total impact of up to + 10 dB. This allows you to play more vividly the sounds of brass instruments, cymbals, and percussion attacks.The compression function is a continuously variable function that reduces the + 6 dB peak (2 Vrms maximum output) to -20dBV and simultaneously raises the quiet level from -90dBV to -80dBV, so that the maximum dynamic range of 96 dB can be compressed to 60 dB, which is the same level as LP records.The Ambience control function introduces a new concept developed in the SF-ONE floor-type speaker system. It adds and subtracts LR signals in the mid - and high-frequency range to enhance digital sound. If you control it to the plus side, the sound field will be broad ; if you control it to the minus side, it will be tight.Two LSIs for CD-Player are used, one for signal processing and the other for servocontrol.In addition, a digital filter is incorporated into the signal processing LSI to greatly reduce the load on the following analog filter and prevent the deterioration of phase characteristics.The pickup unit uses a 3-beam system and realizes highly reliable tracing by directing three beams obliquely to the track, reading the signal with the center beam, and detecting the track shift in real time with the other two beams.The error correction method employs a double error correction method based on CIRC.Equipped with a 2-speed search function, if you press the SCAN key during performance, you can fast-forward / rewind while playing at a low speed for the first 3 seconds and at a high speed after that at approximately 1/4 of the normal volume.It is also equipped with functions such as track search, 9-track random program, repeat playback, and index search.The operation status of the DAIR/Compression function can be monitored by three rows of LEDs.The upper and lower LEDs respectively indicate the level change in the high and low ranges after passing through the dbx DYNAMICS circuit. In DAIR mode, they indicate the amount of dynamic range expansion. In Compression mode, they indicate the amount of compression with low levels of sound increasing. Conversely, when high levels of sound are decreasing, the center LED lights from right to left to indicate the amount of compression."

name: DX5
description: "A CD player with a sound quality design and sound effects.A 16-bit 4-times oversampling digital filter is installed as a digital filter, and a third order low-pass filter is installed as an analog filter.This digital filter has an attenuation of more than 76 dB in the stopband of more than 24.1 kHz and eliminates the center frequency of unwanted components to 176.4 kHz. This enables the low-pass filter to be reduced after D/A conversion. As a result, excellent phase characteristics and transient response characteristics are obtained, and resolution is also improved compared to the 14-bit type.The glitchless 16-bit high-speed linear D/A converter is mounted on the D/A converter section independently on the left and right sides.By making the left and right independent, there is no phase shift between channels, and excellent sound localization and high frequency reproduction capability are obtained.A 3-beam laser pickup using a newly developed lens is used in the pickup section.In this method, in addition to the main beam that reads the signal, two sub-beams detect the track shift of the main beam in real time and control it with a servomechanism. This reduces the influence of disc eccentricity, warpage, scratches and dirt, and realizes stable tracing capability.Equipped with three unique sound effects features of dbx, you can adjust D. A. I. R., Compress, and Ambience.In D. A. I. R. (Digital Audio Impact Recovery), this function emphasizes the missing peak component.Even in a wide dynamic range CD, the dynamic range of live music, especially sharp peaks, is suppressed during recording, and D. A. I. R. emphasizes only the instantaneous attack sound, which is the lost peak component, when recorded.It detects a sudden increase in the level of the music signal and gives a strong impact of up to 10 dB. The effect is made natural by the two band operation of high and low band.Compress reduces the dynamic range of a CD from more than 90 dB to a minimum of 60 dB by suppressing large sounds and raising small sounds. This function is useful for low-volume playback in noisy environments or at midnight. It is also ideal for BGM applications.The reduction operation is two band division same as D. A. I. R.The Ambience adjusts the stereo separation by adding and reducing the LR signal in the mid and high range to control the sense of sound spread. Turn the volume to the left to make it tight, and turn it to the right to increase the sense of sound spread.16-track random program function, 1-track / All/A-B repeat function, skip search and index search function are equipped.Equipped with HF and LF 2-band point LED display Dinamics meter that can confirm the operation status of D. A. I. R. and Compress at a glance.Equipped with a touch control attenuator that can adjust the line-out level.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.It is equipped with an error collection display LED which displays the error correction status due to scratch or dirt of the disk.Wireless remote control is included."

name: DX900
description: "CD player with improved sound quality by thorough anti-resonance design.The pickup section moves on two slider shafts for tracing. The DX900 uses a new material, zirconia ceramic for this slider shaft.This material has hardness and abrasion resistance close to that of diamond, and extremely excellent smoothness. It is less susceptible to vibration, and the tracing accuracy is further improved. Moreover, the initial characteristics are maintained for 10 times longer than that of conventional stainless steel materials, and the reliability of the tracking mechanism is improved.The mechanical deck, which is the base of the optical system and drive system, has a hybrid structure in which two kinds of materials with different resonance frequencies are integrated by outsert molding. As a result, high strength and processing accuracy are obtained, and at the same time, resonance sharpness is greatly reduced compared with single materials such as aluminum die-cast, and vibration control is greatly improved, and generation and transmission of unnecessary vibration are effectively reduced.In addition, a three point support system has been adopted for the support system of the entire mechanical deck. Two points on the panel side are supported by a three way flexible damper, and one point on the rear side is designed to be unloaded, thereby eliminating the effects of external vibrations and shocks.Extremely rigid black ceramic is used for the legs, and fine ceramic spacers are placed at four locations where the circuit board is attached to the chassis to prevent vibration transmission to the component parts.The digital filter uses a 16-bit 4-times oversampling digital filter.This eliminates the frequency lower limit of unwanted components from 24.1 kHz to 156.4 kHz and makes the low-pass filter after D/A conversion into a third order Bessel filter with extremely gentle cut-off characteristics, contributing to the simplification of analog circuits and improved sound quality.The D/A converter uses a 16-bit linear D/A converter, and the left and right channels are used independently to eliminate the phase shift between the channels.This D/A converter does not generate glitch, which is a kind of digital noise. It has a very simple structure that eliminates the need for a glitter circuit, which was indispensable in the past, and the analog circuit is only a third order Bessel filter.High-quality parts such as ceramic containing powder electrolytic capacitor, copper foil Styrofoam capacitor, LC-OFC wire rod, etc., which are examined with priority on sound quality are used.An optical transmission method using a photocoupler has been introduced for digital data transmission of emphasis and output mute to the analog system, and the circuits are electrically isolated from each other.The power supply circuit uses a separate system that completely separates digital circuits from analog circuits.It effectively prevents degradation of sound quality in analog circuits due to interference from the digital system and mixing of digital noise.Equipped with a digital output terminal.Self-calendaring 20 keys are used.The 20 keys for direct selection and the calendar function are docked, and the track number of songs recorded on the disc or program is directly displayed with the corresponding keys lit. The keys of songs that have finished playing are turned off so that you can check the progress of the music at a glance.In addition, it is equipped with the Up 10 key, and you can quickly select songs of Track No. 21 or higher.The display section has a multi-mode double display.It is designed with two separate displays that operate continuously. The upper large display shows the track number and number of songs as well as the operating status and the next operation procedure in alphabet. The lower display shows time information such as elapsed time, total playing time, and remaining time for each song. It also shows the index number and order of program songs.It has a program memory function of up to 24 songs.The program contents can be checked by the memory call function.Equipped with a random BGM play function.One track / all tracks / section, program track and peat function is equipped.It is equipped with skip search and index search.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.Wireless remote control with 20 keys is included."
